ingredients.name: Firm tofu
ingredients.about: Pressed soybean curd that holds its shape. Mild and milky; soaks up whatever sauce it sits in.

ingredients.name: Silken tofu
ingredients.about: Unpressed soybean curd, soft as custard. Mild; breaks easily, so it is slid in gently.

ingredients.name: Ground pork
ingredients.about: Minced pork. Fried until crumbly and browned, it gives a sauce savoury depth and texture.

ingredients.name: Pork belly
ingredients.about: Fatty, layered cut of pork. Rich and sweet; the fat renders and the edges crisp in a hot pan.

ingredients.name: Chicken thigh
ingredients.about: Dark, juicy chicken meat. Stays tender through hard frying or gentle poaching.

ingredients.name: White fish fillet
ingredients.about: Mild, flaky fish fillet. Delicate; cooked briefly so the slices stay silky.

ingredients.name: Doubanjiang (Pixian chili bean paste)
ingredients.about: Fermented broad bean and chili paste. Salty, deep and hot. Fried in oil first, until the oil turns red.

ingredients.name: Fermented black beans (douchi)
ingredients.about: Small black soybeans, salted and fermented. Pungent, salty and savoury; a spoonful goes a long way.

ingredients.name: Sichuan peppercorns, whole
ingredients.about: Dried husks of a small citrus-family berry. Lemony, and they make the lips tingle and go numb.

ingredients.name: Sichuan peppercorn, ground
ingredients.about: The numbing, lemony husks, toasted and ground. Sprinkled on at the end so the tingle stays fresh.

ingredients.name: Dried red chilies, whole
ingredients.about: Whole dried red chilies. Toasted in oil until dark, for smoky fragrance more than raw fire.

ingredients.name: Chili flakes
ingredients.about: Coarsely ground dried chilies. Direct heat and red colour, stirred into oil or a sauce.

ingredients.name: Chili oil (hong you)
ingredients.about: Oil infused with ground chilies, red and fragrant. Adds heat, colour and gloss, often as a dressing.

ingredients.name: Pickled red chilies (pao la jiao)
ingredients.about: Red chilies fermented in brine. Hot, sour and fruity; chopped and fried to start a sauce.

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.about: Minced garlic. Sharp when raw, sweet and nutty once fried. An aromatic that starts a dish.

ingredients.name: Ginger, minced
ingredients.about: Minced fresh ginger. Warm, bright and peppery; fried briefly with the other aromatics.

ingredients.name: Scallion, chopped
ingredients.about: Chopped green onion. A mild onion bite; whites fried at the start, greens scattered at the end.

ingredients.name: Leek or green garlic, sliced
ingredients.about: Sliced leek or green garlic shoots. Sweet and mildly oniony; tossed in near the end to stay bright.

ingredients.name: Light soy sauce
ingredients.about: Thin, salty soy sauce. The everyday seasoning for salt and savouriness.

ingredients.name: Dark soy sauce
ingredients.about: Thick, aged soy sauce. Less salty and slightly sweet; used in small amounts for deep colour.

ingredients.name: Chinkiang black vinegar
ingredients.about: Dark, aged rice vinegar. Malty, mellow and sour, with a little sweetness.

ingredients.name: Shaoxing wine
ingredients.about: Amber rice wine. Nutty and dry; a splash takes the raw edge off meat and fish.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.about: White sugar. Sweetens, and in small amounts rounds off salt, sourness and heat.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.about: Plain salt. Seasons, and draws water out of vegetables.

ingredients.name: Cornstarch
ingredients.about: Fine starch. Stirred in with water to thicken a sauce to a gloss, or dusted on meat to keep it tender.

ingredients.name: Neutral oil
ingredients.about: Flavourless cooking oil. Carries heat and takes on the flavour of whatever is fried in it.

ingredients.name: Toasted sesame oil
ingredients.about: Oil pressed from toasted sesame seeds. Strong and nutty; a few drops at the end, not for frying.

ingredients.name: Chinese sesame paste
ingredients.about: Paste of toasted sesame seeds. Thick, nutty and a little bitter; loosened into dressings and sauces.

ingredients.name: Toasted sesame seeds
ingredients.about: Toasted sesame seeds. A nutty crunch, scattered on at the end.

ingredients.name: Roasted peanuts
ingredients.about: Roasted peanuts. Crunch and a toasty sweetness, added last so they stay crisp.

ingredients.name: Chicken stock
ingredients.about: Light chicken broth. The liquid for braises and soups; savoury without being heavy.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.about: Plain water. Loosens a sauce or carries a braise without adding flavour.

ingredients.name: Yacai (Yibin preserved mustard)
ingredients.about: Mustard greens, salted, dried and fermented. Salty, sweet and deeply savoury; fried in small amounts.

ingredients.name: Sweet bean sauce (tianmianjiang)
ingredients.about: Thick fermented wheat and soybean sauce. Dark, salty-sweet and mellow.

ingredients.name: Eggplant
ingredients.about: Long eggplant. Spongy when raw, silky once cooked; it drinks up oil and sauce.

ingredients.name: Green beans
ingredients.about: Fresh green beans. Fried hard, they wrinkle, blister and turn sweet.

ingredients.name: Fresh wheat noodles
ingredients.about: Fresh wheat noodles. Springy and plain; boiled, then dressed.

ingredients.name: Glass noodles (dry)
ingredients.about: Dried noodles made from bean starch. Clear and slippery once soaked; they absorb sauce.

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.about: Fresh cucumber. Cool, crisp and watery; usually served raw or smashed.

ingredients.name: Bean sprouts
ingredients.about: Sprouted mung beans. Crisp and juicy; barely cooked, often as a bed under something richer.

ingredients.name: Napa cabbage
ingredients.about: Pale, tender cabbage. Sweet and juicy; wilts quickly in broth.

ingredients.name: Celery
ingredients.about: Celery stalks. Crisp, with a fresh, slightly bitter bite.

ingredients.name: Egg white
ingredients.about: Egg white. Coats sliced meat or fish so it stays silky when cooked.

ingredients.name: White pepper
ingredients.about: Ground white pepper. A sharp, earthy heat that hits the nose more than the tongue.

ingredients.name: Cilantro
ingredients.about: Fresh coriander leaves. Bright and citrusy; a garnish added at the end.

ingredients.name: Rice vinegar
ingredients.about: Clear rice vinegar. A light, clean sourness.

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.about: Fresh tomato. Sweet, sour and juicy; cooks down into a soft sauce.

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.about: Ground cumin seed. Warm, earthy and strong; common with grilled and fried meat.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.about: Ground black pepper. A woody, sharp heat.

ingredients.name: Chopped salted chilies (duojiao)
ingredients.about: Fresh red chilies, chopped and salted until they ferment. Bright, sour, salty and hot.

ingredients.name: Oyster sauce
ingredients.about: Thick sauce made from oyster extract. Sweet, salty and briny; adds gloss and savouriness.

ingredients.name: Hoisin sauce
ingredients.about: Thick, dark sauce of fermented soybean, sugar and spice. Sweet and salty, like a barbecue glaze.

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.about: Thin amber liquid from salted, fermented fish. Very salty and pungent; savoury depth by the drop.

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.about: Fresh lime juice. A sharp, fragrant sourness, added at the end.

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.about: Milk pressed from coconut flesh. Rich, sweet and creamy; the base of many curries and soups.

ingredients.name: Lemongrass
ingredients.about: Tough, lemon-scented stalk. Bruised or sliced to perfume broths and pastes.

ingredients.name: Basil
ingredients.about: Fresh basil leaves. Sweet, peppery and aniseed-scented; torn in at the end.

ingredients.name: Cream
ingredients.about: Dairy cream. Rich and mild; softens heat and thickens a sauce.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.about: Dairy butter. Rich and sweet; browns and turns nutty in a hot pan.

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.about: Hard aged cheese. Salty, nutty and savoury; grated over a finished dish.

ingredients.name: Mirin
ingredients.about: Sweet rice wine. Syrupy and mild; gives sauces sweetness and shine.

ingredients.name: Miso
ingredients.about: Paste of fermented soybeans and grain. Salty, earthy and savoury; dissolved into soups and glazes.

ingredients.name: Gochujang
ingredients.about: Thick red paste of chili, fermented soybean and sticky rice. Hot, sweet and savoury.

ingredients.name: Curry powder
ingredients.about: Blend of ground spices, yellow with turmeric. Warm and earthy.

ingredients.name: Ketchup
ingredients.about: Sweet and sour tomato sauce, smooth and thick.
